patterns.component_pattern: All dashboard pages use 'use client' directive for client-side interactivity
patterns.list_rendering: Current pattern uses direct .map() on filtered arrays inside Card components
patterns.ui_components: Custom UI components in components/ui/ (Card, Input, Button, Modal)
patterns.styling: Tailwind CSS with dark mode support (dark: prefix), responsive breakpoints (sm:, md:)
patterns.state_management: useState and useEffect hooks for local state, useAuth for organization context
patterns.supabase_client: Uses createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client for data fetching
patterns.error_handling: Try-catch with error state messages displayed in alert boxes

existing_implementations.description: ProductListItem component renders each product with image, visibility toggle, edit/delete actions. Categories page has similar tree-node rendering pattern.

current_rendering.container: div with divide-y classes inside CardContent

dependencies.rationale: @tanstack/react-virtual is lightweight, well-maintained, React 19 compatible, and works seamlessly with Next.js App Router

performance_context.current_issue: All products rendered in DOM simultaneously causing bloat with 100+ items
performance_context.target: Only render visible items (~20-30) regardless of total count
performance_context.expected_improvement: 90% reduction in DOM nodes, smoother scrolling, reduced memory usage
